data.name: Divine Retribution
data.description: As a standard action, you can point at one creature within 30 feet to indicate that it is the target of divine wrath. A mishap or an accident appropriate to the environment occurs, such as a branch falling on the creature, rocks falling from the ceiling, or some other nonmagical misfortune; regardless of the cause, the mishap deals 1d6+%1 points of damage (Reflex DC %2 half). The GM decides whether this damage is bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. You can use this ability %3 times per day.|DivineRetributionBonusDamage|DivineRetributionDC|DomainVengeanceTimes
